newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shangri-La to sell Hong Kong unit shares.
newsitem.headline: Shangri-La to sell Hong Kong unit shares.

text.p: Shangri-La Hotel Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell 35.5 million shares in Shangri-La Asia Ltd to a subsidiary of the Singapore government's investment arm for Hong Kong $355 million.
The sale of the shares to Hong Lim Investments Pte Ltd, a subsidiary of Temasek Holdings (Pte) Ltd, would be completed on June 10, the company said in a statement.
After the sale, the company's stake in Shangri-La Asia would be revised to a total of 148.86 million shares, representing 9.4 percent of its issued capital against 11.7 percent previously.
At the same time, Hong Lim had entered an agreement with members of the Kuok group for the purchase of 35 million additional Shangri-La Asia shares at the same price of HK$10 per share.
